wikipediaSummary.title: Tattoo You
wikipediaSummary.description: 1981 studio album by the Rolling Stones
wikipediaSummary.extract: Tattoo You is the sixteenth UK and eighteenth US studio album by the English rock band the Rolling Stones, released on 24 August 1981 by Rolling Stones Records. The album is mostly composed of studio outtakes recorded during the 1970s, and contains one of the band's most well-known songs, "Start Me Up", which hit number two on the US Billboard singles charts.
